tasks.subject: Task 1: Settings layout + 4 sub-pages + redirect
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move all 5 existing settings cards into 4 dedicated sub-pages under a shared layout, with the bare `/settings` URL redirecting to the first one.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/settings/layout.tsx`
- Create: `src/app/settings/account/page.tsx`
- Create: `src/app/settings/billing/page.tsx`
- Create: `src/app/settings/team/page.tsx`
- Create: `src/app/settings/integrations/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/settings/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `/settings` redirects (HTTP redirect) to `/settings/account`
- [ ] `/settings/account` renders only ChangePasswordCard
- [ ] `/settings/billing` renders only BillingCard with correct planTier/subscriptionStatus
- [ ] `/settings/team` renders only TeamCard with correct currentUserId/currentUserRole
- [ ] `/settings/integrations` renders both ShopifyConnectionCard and WooCommerceConnectionCard
- [ ] Every settings page wrapped in AppShell with merchant name shown
- [ ] Unauthenticated visitors redirected to /login via layout's requireSessionPage()

**Verify:** No automated test (pure page/routing restructure) — manual browser verification per plan Step 7.

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-settings-restructure.md Task 1 for full code.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Expandable Settings section in the sidebar
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the flat "Settings" sidebar link with an expandable group showing the 4 new sub-pages, expanded only while inside /settings/*.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/Sidebar.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Outside /settings/*, sidebar shows a single unchanged "Settings" row, no sub-items
- [ ] Under /settings/*, sidebar shows "Settings" row plus 4 indented sub-items (Account/Billing/Team/Integrations)
- [ ] Sub-item matching current exact path is highlighted (bg-accent), others are not
- [ ] Parent "Settings" row never gets the accent-highlight treatment itself
- [ ] Clicking Settings navigates to /settings; clicking a sub-item navigates directly
- [ ] Dashboard/Launch Planner/Guide nav items unchanged

**Verify:** No automated test (no Sidebar.test.tsx exists in this codebase) — manual browser verification per plan Step 3.

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-settings-restructure.md Task 2 for full code.

```json:metadata

```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Full-suite verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Confirm the restructure integrates cleanly with no regressions before merge.

**Files:** None (verification only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Full test suite passes, same count as pre-restructure baseline
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds, all 5 settings routes listed in output, no new type errors
- [ ] Stripe Portal return_url (`/settings`) checked and confirmed to still resolve sensibly; note (don't silently fix) whether it should point at /settings/billing instead
- [ ] Full manual click-through: Dashboard → Settings → each of the 4 sub-pages via sidebar nav (not direct URL), confirming every card still works exactly as before

**Verify:** `npm test && npm run build` → both succeed
